statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-96230 (GHSA-qjpx-jqm5-h2c4) is an ASP.NET Core remote code execution issue in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server: the Blazor WebAssembly development-server debug page can reflect unencoded exception text, allowing cross-origin script injection through the unauthenticated /_framework/debug endpoint used by dotnet watch. Microsoft lists only the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server NuGet package as affected, from 10.0.0 through 10.0.12, fixed in 10.0.13 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qjpx-jqm5-h2c4, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/478, https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/discussions/69802, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). The fix encodes the exception text in that package's debug page (TargetPickerUi) and in the debug-proxy page of the mono WebAssembly development server (dotnet/dotnet commit 2c81aaf1a5905b59c488aa176ef8ee1ade4a897f on release/10.0.1xx). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's dotnet/dotnet source release, and each build's version is the .NET release it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: no package contains a Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server assembly or nupkg, a Blazor WebAssembly development server (DevServer), the BrowserDebugHost or BrowserDebugProxy debugging proxy, or any Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly assembly. The Blazor WebAssembly files they do hold are the Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly and Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly build tasks of the .NET SDK (in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap and as nupkg files in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts), with their debug symbol files in the symbols archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, the Microsoft.NET.WebAssembly.Threading reference package in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, the Blazor WebAssembly project templates in the Microsoft.DotNet.Web.ProjectTemplates package (in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts and in the templates folder of the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap), and the WasmFeatures.props file of the Mono toolchain workload manifest (in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap and in a nupkg in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts), none of which contains the debug page. The same scan finds the ASP.NET Core Components server assembly (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server.dll) in every build, so the search covers ASP.NET Core Components files. The affected package is not part of this owner.
